COLD GEOMETRY WALK-THROUGH

Pair the wafers, check the projected overlap

  1. Switch to the reconstructed inspection fixture and seat the two inert wafers.
  2. Use a half-width offset, optionally add the known void, and inspect the resulting patch area. Comparison uses the lower wafer’s face coordinates.
  3. Export a review with both parent IDs and revisions. It reports where the rectangles overlap, not actual bonded area or strength.
Handbook, references and verification

Texas A&M exact installation, Rev. B, pp. 6–8. The documented top-down views establish the chamber, carrier face, tabs, clamps, and transparent cover. The original exterior model is preserved; the interior inspection fixture is separate. No hinge kinematics, service procedure or equipment recipe is claimed.

The default example uses two 10 × 10 mm windows. Half-width shift gives 50 mm², and a known 2 × 3 mm mask leaves 44 mm². These are projected geometry only, not measured contact or bonding. The JSON includes both untouched parent revisions and the full polygons and mask intersections.
